# Sticky OS

> Free, open-source (MIT) firmware for the Seeed reTerminal Sticky, the 3.97-inch 800 x 480 touch e-paper board with an ESP32-S3. It gives the board a home screen of glanceable apps: clock, weather, calendar (Google, iCloud or Outlook iCal links), notes and voice notes, timer, photos, quote of the day, an e-reader (EPUB, MOBI, AZW3, FB2, PDF), recipes and twelve games (among them Solitaire, Mines, Four in a Row and Chess). Set up from the browser over USB or Bluetooth; no account and no cloud. It does not run on the reTerminal E1001 or E1002. Independent; not made by or affiliated with Seeed Studio.

- [Home: tour, apps, install, FAQ](https://sticky-os.space.fast/)
- [Setup app (Chrome or Edge)](https://sticky-os.space.fast/setup/)
- [How to play the games](https://sticky-os.space.fast/games/): the twelve games (2048, Memory, Maths Quest, Daily maths, Quiz, Adventure, X and O, Tutor, Solitaire, Mines, Four in a Row, Chess): goal, steps, tips and what is kept, with the board's screens step by step.
- [Source, README and install steps](https://github.com/Sticky-OS/sticky-os)
- [Latest release](https://github.com/Sticky-OS/sticky-os/releases/latest)

## Guides

- [How to install custom firmware on the reTerminal Sticky](https://sticky-os.space.fast/blog/install-custom-firmware-reterminal-sticky/): Flashing Sticky OS on the reTerminal Sticky: a backup, esptool or ESP Tool at 115200 baud, the first start, common errors and going back.
- [Your Google Calendar on an e-paper fridge display, no subscription](https://sticky-os.space.fast/blog/google-calendar-e-paper-fridge-display-no-subscription/): Google, iCloud or Outlook on the reTerminal Sticky through a secret iCal link: up to three calendars, every 30 minutes, no account and no subscription.
- [reTerminal Sticky e-reader: EPUB, MOBI and PDF from a microSD card](https://sticky-os.space.fast/blog/reterminal-sticky-e-reader-epub-mobi-pdf-microsd-card/): EPUB, MOBI, AZW3, FB2 and PDF from a microSD card: putting books on the card, the library, text sizes, bookmarks and statistics.
- [reTerminal Sticky firmware compared: Seeedash, Sticky OS, TRMNL, CrossPoint and ESPHome](https://sticky-os.space.fast/blog/reterminal-sticky-firmware-compared-seeedash-sticky-os-trmnl-crosspoint-esphome/): Seeedash, Sticky OS, TRMNL, CrossPoint Reader, ESPHome and OpenDisplay side by side, and which to pick.
- [Restore the Seeedash firmware on the reTerminal Sticky](https://sticky-os.space.fast/blog/restore-seeedash-firmware-reterminal-sticky/): Seeed's official web flasher, or your own 32 MB backup with esptool: how to go back to the stock firmware.
- [reTerminal Sticky games: 2048, Memory, maths, quiz and more](https://sticky-os.space.fast/blog/reterminal-sticky-games-2048-memory-maths-quiz/): 2048, Memory, Maths Quest, Daily maths, Quiz, Adventure, X and O, and Tutor: the eight games and their controls.
